measured_problem: The best fixed-budget mapper narrowly missed the held-out gates while the recurring worst record had its 161-action source truncated to 128 actions, retained none of its 22 answer-context actions, and contained 30.38% actions unseen within its capability training subset. Across the locked split, 104 of 420 training records and 7 of 28 validation records were truncated despite the host supporting 512 actions.
proposed_method: Repeat the single previously best 3072-by-576-by-768 SiLU capacity screen with no architectural or training change, replacing only the artificial 128-action calibration cap with the host's canonical 512-action bound so every selected record is represented in full.
material_differences: Tests one measured acquisition-protocol defect rather than changing mapper capacity or quality gates.
Uses exactly the same 420 training and 28 validation record identities and the same deterministic split.
Keeps the fixed nonlinear architecture, seed, optimizer, steps, learning rate, loss, rank, routes, attention, and source unchanged.
Does not add teacher records, parameters, routes, or artifact bytes.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered context-complete layer-zero control. A pass authorizes host construction and extraction; any miss closes context truncation as a sufficient repair without context-length, mapper, training, data, route, rank, attention, layer, or source sweeps.
claim_boundary: Architecture-review authorization only; no fit, causal conclusion, extracted model, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority evidence.
